description: Reverse-ETL sink: create one Asana task per row of an upstream DataFrame. Asana has no upsert concept for tasks -- re-running on the same data creates duplicate tasks. Intended for 'spin up a task per flagged row' patterns (e.g. data-quality failures), not for mirroring a table over time.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one new Asana task.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Asana.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

name_column.label: Name Column
name_column.description: Upstream column holding the task name.

notes_column.label: Notes Column
notes_column.description: Upstream column holding the task notes/description.

project_gids.label: Project Gids
project_gids.description: Asana project GIDs to add every created task to.

assignee_column.label: Assignee Column
assignee_column.description: Upstream column holding an Asana user GID or email to assign the task to.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Asana Task Create
